user.title: Connect to the modem diagnostics page
user.description: Enter the URL of the Thomson cable modem Diagnostics.asp page. Most modems use http://192.168.100.1/Diagnostics.asp without authentication.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the URL, username and password.
